multi_entity_note: Transporter Arkansas Western Pipeline and shipper Associated Natural Gas, with replacement shipper United Cities Gas (Atmos) and several listed contracts.
processing_note: To be executed, prior to posting by Transporter, by Replacement Shipper only if Replacement Shipper has been designated by Releasing Shipper in G(i) above.

contract.document_name.rationale: The heading names the contract "TRANSPORTATION SERVICE AGREEMENT", and the headings of Exhibits A and B repeat the name.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement is "entered into on May 20, 1992" and executed as of the same date; Schedule 2 lists it as "AWP FT dated 5/20/92".

contract.effective_date.rationale: The agreement takes effect on the date of physical completion and initial deliveries, which is not given as a calendar date.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: Schedule 2 lists the expiration of this contract (AWP FT dated 5/20/92) as 07/31/2003; the other dates are for other contracts or forms.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 8.2 says the agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Arkansas; the other Arkansas mentions are company names.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: After the ten-year primary term, the agreement continues month to month.

contract.notice_period.rationale: Firm service under Rate Schedule FTS (the service selected) needs 180 days' written notice to end the month-to-month continuation; 60 days applies to interruptible ITS service.
